page.content:
Gold band Guanyin gives Sanzang to control Wukong.

How Tightening fillet connects

  • Character: Sun Wukong — The fillet is the pain-band that binds Wukong to Sanzang.
  • Character: Tang Sanzang — Sanzang recites the spell that tightens the fillet.

What is Tightening fillet?

The tightening fillet clamps Wukong's brow. When Sanzang recites the spell, pain forces the disciple back from murder and desertion — the novel's check on divine violence.

Key threads lead to Sun Wukong and Tang Sanzang.
